$comment: contract-version 0.1.0 — store-to-store object re-homing. Moves a workspace's objects between two object-store BACKENDS (e.g. the global R2 -> a tenant's own MinIO) with the COMPUTE fixed. The inverse of workspace-migration (which moves compute with the store fixed). A sub-contract of the object-store family: CONSUMES contracts/object-store (the Backend pair + the operation set) + contracts/workspace-data (the key scheme + persisted set). The copy/verify/cutover orchestration is NET-NEW — the ObjectStore seam has List/Get/Put/Delete but no Copy, no store-pair, no checksum/resume today; this contract governs that net-new protocol.
title: Data Migration (Store-to-Store Object Re-home) Contract
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for re-homing a workspace's persisted objects from one object-store backend to another — the operation the R2->per-tenant-MinIO swap needs. Compute stays put; the store is re-homed. Per workspace it copies the keys under the workspace-data prefix (latest.tar.zst; later image-gen blobs + attachments) from a SOURCE backend to a TARGET backend over the object-store operation set, verifies, and cuts the tenant's endpoint over only after verification. The SDK owns this SHAPE + the state machine + the copy/verify invariants; the implementation is net-new in molecule-controlplane. Reuses the object-store/workspace-data constants (key scheme, Backend enum, persisted paths) rather than redefining them.

operation.description: Re-home objects between backends; compute is fixed. Inverse of workspace-migration.

direction.description: A backend PAIR from object-store's Backend enum. The canonical case is r2 -> minio (the per-tenant MinIO adoption).

scope.description: What moves, per workspace. v1 = the snapshot; later phases add image-gen blobs + attachments (each its own bucket/prefix).

states.description: Mirrors workspace-migration's shape (a state machine + terminal set) so the two migration contracts are consistent.

protocol.description: The net-new copy/verify/cutover protocol over the object-store operation set.

copy.description: No native Copy on the seam; compose List(source prefix)->Get each->Put target.

manifest_unit.description: The ObjectStore List item {Key,SizeBytes,CreatedAt} is the manifest/diff unit.

reuses.description: Constants owned by object-store/workspace-data — referenced, NOT redefined (single source).

status.description: The copy/verify/resume/cutover orchestration + a Copy primitive do not exist today; this contract is the SSOT the implementation will conform to.
